name: CheckDot Protocol
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs explorer label and description.
rootCause: CheckDot Protocol on BSC was targeted by an attacker who submitted a malicious governance proposal designed to drain approximately $120K from the protocol's treasury. The access control issue stemmed from insufficient validation or gatekeeping in the governance proposal execution pathway — the smart contract did not adequately restrict which proposal actions could be executed or failed to enforce a meaningful timelock, allowing a malicious proposal to be enacted before the community could respond. BlockSec's Phalcon system detected the attack and alerted the CheckDot team, who acknowledged the threat as critical and implemented a patch. The incident was confirmed by Phalcon on approximately February 1–4, 2024 (the on-chain submission date is recorded as January 31, 2024 in the incident list). Attack Tx: 0xdd19e3a1657f8381b561c4d6c9b61be67380e10fd4d367ccad6e8cf28c114e72 Analysis: Phalcon_xyz alert — CheckDot Protocol
